title: Time and place in sentences
instructions: A week later, Sofia visits her grandma in another town. She tells her grandma what people said. Change the **time and place expressions**.

items.direct: Diego: "I'm going to the gym tomorrow."
items.text: Diego said that he was going to the gym {{the next day|the following day}}.
Mila said that she had called her parents {{the day before|the previous day}}.
Aisha said that she was really busy {{that day}}.

items.direct: Tyler (at the skate park): "I meet my friends here every weekend."
items.text: Tyler said that he met his friends {{there}} every weekend.
items.hint: here → there (Sofia isn't at the skate park now).

items.direct: Mrs Moreno: "We'll go camping next week."
items.text: Mrs Moreno said that they would go camping {{the following week|the next week|the week after}}.

items.direct: Mr Okafor: "The school trip was three days ago."
items.text: Mr Okafor said that the school trip had been {{three days before|three days earlier}}.
items.hint: three days ago → three days before / earlier

items.direct: Sofia's friend: "I moved to this town last year."
items.text: Sofia's friend said that she had moved to {{that}} town {{the year before|the previous year}}.
items.hint: this → that, last year → the year before

items.direct: Diego (at school): "There is a concert here tonight."
items.text: Diego said that there was a concert {{there}} {{that night|that evening}}.
